Class MessageDispatcher

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.MessageDispatcher
All Implemented Interfaces:
IMessageVisitor
public class MessageDispatcher extends Object implements IMessageVisitor
Receives incoming Message and dispatches them asynchronously to the appropriate handler (UpdateHandler or ErrorHandler) using the visitor pattern. The internal executor works as a buffer that immediately frees the connection thread. Ordered processing is guaranteed by the single-threaded executor.
